bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
git -C "$ROOT" remote get-url origin | grep -Eq 'GateApp-Bot(\.git)?$'
TARGET=5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
git fetch --no-tags origin "$TARGET" >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
if [ -e "$WT" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
 test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
else
 mkdir -p "$ROOT/.worktrees"
 git worktree add --detach "$WT" "$TARGET" >/dev/null
fi
docker build -q -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "$CANDIDATE" "$WT" >/dev/null
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
printf 'SEARCH_COLORS_CANDIDATE=BUILT\n'
